propositions: A stale clone with mismatched store epoch must refuse to union in sync._union_merge and return without merging, preserving both pre-operation refs unchanged.
A stale clone with mismatched store epoch reaching push.py non-fast-forward retry must return immediately without merge or re-push attempts, leaving local and remote tips byte-for-byte unchanged.

The epoch guard must check both local and remote .store-compat.json records via git show for the remote ref, and abort on mismatch, corrupt record, or unreadable remote ref with distinct log messages.
Clones with matching epochs or no epoch fields must continue to converge via fast-forward or ordinary union, and merely-behind clones must not be blocked.

The full state matrix of 9 rows must be enforced: absent/absent, absent/present-absent, present-absent/present-absent, equal-epoch, mismatched-epoch, local-absent-remote-present, local-present-remote-absent, corrupt record, and unreadable remote ref.
